name: cadence
note: thriftrw corpus: .gen/go carries one thriftrw-generated file per package with an embedded thriftreflect.ThriftModule (Name/Package/FilePath/SHA1/Raw), and common/types/mapper/thrift holds real handwritten accessor call sites in the same repository. The idls gitlink names the IDL source commit; clone with --filter=blob:none, the checkout materializes every blob the gates read.

name: cadence-idl
note: IDL boundary corpus: pinned to exactly the commit cadence's idls gitlink names, so the G2 SHA1 digest join between each embedded ThriftModule and thrift/<FilePath> is exact-by-construction rather than a heuristic pairing. Cadence IDLs declare no `namespace go`, so scope falls back to the file basename, matching each module's Name.

name: jaeger-client-go
note: Apache Thrift corpus (t191 pin reused): archived repository, vendors thrift-gen stubs from Thrift Compiler 0.14.1 with `thrift:"name,ID[,required]"` struct tags and real in-repo composite-literal write sites (transport_udp.go builds jaeger.Batch). Predates Go modules; ensureCorpus fences it with a stub go.mod.

name: jaeger-idl
note: Apache cross-check corpus (t191 pin reused): thrift/jaeger.thrift declares the Batch/Process/Span structs whose generated tags G4 verifies. The IDL lives outside jaeger-client-go, demonstrating that Apache generated Go has no in-file source identity — the tag-to-IDL join crosses repositories, which is why Apache rows stay derived.
